opportunities.title: APEX Awards

amount.raw: Applicants can apply for up to £200,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a strong track record, holding a permanent or fixed-term position covering the duration of the award, with teaching and admin duties, based in a UK University or UK not-for-profit research organisation. Lead applicant may include up to two Co-applicants covering a different Academy remit.
opportunities.summary: Cross-disciplinary, curiosity-driven research awards (Academies Partnership in Supporting Excellence in Cross-disciplinary research) in partnership with the Royal Society, Royal Academy of Engineering and Leverhulme Trust, promoting collaboration across science, engineering, social sciences and humanities. Awards up to 24 months.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any researcher based in the UK who meets the conditions of the call; no prior British Academy funding required; some prior public engagement experience expected; previous successful recipients not eligible to reapply.
opportunities.summary: Public engagement programme supporting ambitious projects to engage the public with the humanities and social sciences, working in partnership with a gallery, archive, library or museum (GLAM) or performing arts organisation.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: FEC regime; Academy funds 80% of salary costs, directly allocated and indirect costs under FEC; three-year fellowship

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers in humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research organisation. British citizens and EEA nationals eligible regardless of doctorate origin; any nationality with a UK doctorate eligible; Viva Voce completed between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027; must not have held a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three-year fellowship for outstanding early-career researchers in the humanities or social sciences to pursue an independent research project towards a significant piece of publishable research, funded by DSIT.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in humanities and social sciences ordinarily resident in the UK, holding a current long-term appointment at a UK-based HEI or IRO continuing for the full duration of the award, intending to pursue original independent research in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Awards to promote acquisition and advancement of skills in areas such as quantitative skills, data science, digital humanities and languages, supporting innovative research methods, skills development, collaboration and dissemination. Awards of 6-12 months.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027

amount.raw: The symposium covers travel, accommodation, and visa costs; seed funding available for collaborations

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany, in the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Research collaboration symposium on the theme 'Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future', bringing together around fifteen early career researchers from the UK and fifteen from Germany to encourage collaboration and networking, with seed funding available for international collaborations.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: Up to £300,000 over 2 years at 80% FEC (total project value at 100% FEC may not exceed £375,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal Investigator must be a researcher from the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research institute holding an established role lasting the duration of the award, of postdoctoral or above status, spending at least 20% time on the award; overseas Co-Applicants required.
opportunities.summary: International interdisciplinary research projects led by UK-based humanities/social sciences researchers with international partners, on the theme of Mobilities, ranging across SHAPE and STEM disciplines. Projects of 24 months.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27

amount.raw: Up to £150,000 for 12 months (with Full Economic Costing at 80 per cent)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships providing opportunities for UK-based early and mid-career researchers to develop skills, networks and careers in the policy sector, embedded in the office of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) in Berlin, producing policy-relevant analysis. Up to two one-year fellowships.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs

amount.raw: Funding of up to £4,000 (exceptional cases above £4,000 considered)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award-holders on any scheme, or applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award in the next six months who meet the eligibility requirements of the scheme they intend to apply for.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support additional needs that applicants and award-holders may require, in addition to the amount already requested for research expenses, such as specific equipment to overcome barriers to disabled people, assistance for sensory impairment, caring costs for research trips, and support to make applications. Rolling deadline.
